g.text: Figure 4. One case through the method: Uiseong–Andong at 18:00 KST on 25 March 2025. Inputs (a); the forecast model's learned spread kernels and next-hour

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: chance of burning (b); heat, shown on the US Fish Creek fire because no Korean fuel maps exist (c). The road plan uses the detected fire, not (b)–(c): the known fire

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: plus a calibrated 10 km margin (d) sets when each road is blocked, and a backward pass gives Wondang-ri a leave-by time of 18:15 and a route that an independent

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: checker accepted (e–f). At this hour the gate withheld the answer: the fire was unlike every calibration fire.
